# 5 Ways The Work Number Database Helps Move Life Forward


October 07, 2026


When people apply for a loan, lease an apartment, or apply for government benefits, confirming their employment and income is usually part of the process. Relying on paper pay stubs, phone calls, and faxed forms can slow things down — and add unnecessary stress to decisions that already carry enough weight.


[The Work Number](https://theworknumber.com/) ® database from Equifax helps make these moments simpler, through automated, digital verifications of your employment and income information. That helps you keep your most important life events moving forward.


Here are five ways The Work Number database can help make life easier.


#### 1. Help Speed Up Important Financial Decisions


When you apply for a mortgage or auto loan, lenders typically need to confirm where you work and how much money you make. Since more than 5 million employers trust The Work Number database to provide employment and income verifications on their behalf, a lender can often verify an employee’s information instantly through The Work Number database without the need for them to track down pay stubs or wait for their employer to return a call. That can mean faster answers and a smoother path to the credit decision you are seeking.


#### 2. Get the Help You Need, When You Need It


Life does not stick to business hours. Those who have shopped for a car in the evening or finished a lease application on the weekend, know how frustrating it can be to wait for information. In 2025, The Work Number database helped 58 million people benefit from instant verifications completed outside of regular business hours. With 24/7 access, employees can get the answers they need, no matter the day or time. And with The Work Number database this happens automatically as part of their loan or lease application process — there’s no need to download another app or create separate login credentials.


#### 3. Keep Your Information More Secure and Private


Employee employment and income data is personal, and access to it is tightly controlled. Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), any organization requesting information through The Work Number database must complete a thorough credentialing process and have a legally required permissible purpose. Access is limited to credentialed verifiers such as lenders, background screeners, and social service agencies — helping protect employee data while still keeping important processes moving.


#### 4. Manage Your Employment Data


Employee information on The Work Number database is more than just data, it’s the story of their hard work. That’s why Equifax makes it easier for them to manage their employment data. Employees can[log in](https://employees.theworknumber.com/) to view their Employment Data Report, which shows which data of theirs is on The Work Number database as well as the names of verifiers that have requested their information the last 24 months. In the unlikely event that someone finds an error, they can initiate a data dispute so it can be corrected. Employees also have the ability to freeze their data, but should keep in mind that could slow down applications for things like a loan, a lease, or social service benefits.


#### 5. Support More of Life's Important Moments


The Work Number database helps with more than just loans. In 2025, it provided verifications for 8 million people seeking auto loans, 20.4 million people applying for government benefits, and 4.6 million job applicants confirming their work history. Whether they are buying a car, applying for assistance, or starting a new job, automated verifications can help the people reviewing the application make faster, better-informed decisions.
